description: This file contains helper functions for managing zones in Kubernetes, including conversions between zone representations, selecting zones for volumes based on various parameters, and hashing volume names for zone distribution.

methods.name: LabelZonesToSet
methods.description: Converts a PV label value from a delimited string of zones to a set.

methods.name: ZonesSetToLabelValue
methods.description: Converts a set of zones to a delimited string label value.

methods.name: ZonesToSet
methods.description: Parses a comma-separated string of zones into a set.

methods.name: stringToSet
methods.description: Converts a delimited string into a set of trimmed strings, erroring on empty entries.

methods.name: LabelZonesToList
methods.description: Converts a delimited string of zones to a list.

methods.name: stringToList
methods.description: Converts a delimited string into a list of trimmed strings, erroring on empty entries.

methods.name: SelectZoneForVolume
methods.description: Selects a single zone for volume provisioning based on parameters and topology.

methods.name: SelectZonesForVolume
methods.description: Determines zones for volume provisioning based on node, parameters, and topologies.

methods.name: chooseZonesForVolumeIncludingZone
methods.description: Ensures a specific zone is included when selecting zones for a volume.

methods.name: ChooseZonesForVolume
methods.description: Selects multiple zones for multi-zone volume creation, distributing across zones based on hashing.

methods.name: getPVCNameHashAndIndexOffset
methods.description: Generates a hash and index offset from a PVC name to distribute volumes across zones.
